input_prompt: Design a crew management game with: 6 departments, crisis events, skill trees, ship upgrades, alien diplomacy, boarding actions, mutiny system

rules.name: Crew Management
rules.description: Manage your crew's skills, morale, and relationships to optimize their performance.

rules.name: Resource Management
rules.description: Manage your ship's resources, including food, water, and medical supplies.

rules.name: Crisis Events
rules.description: Respond to crisis events, such as alien attacks or system failures, to protect your crew and ship.

rules.name: Alien Diplomacy
rules.description: Negotiate with alien species to trade resources, form alliances, or resolve conflicts.

rules.name: Boarding Actions
rules.description: Engage in boarding actions against enemy ships to capture resources or disable their operations.

rules.name: Mutiny System
rules.description: Manage your crew's morale and relationships to prevent mutinies and maintain order.

interactions.result: Capture resources or disable enemy ship
Prevent mutiny or increase crew's loyalty

transitions.trigger: Player chooses to engage in boarding action

implementation_steps: Create department buildings and assign crew members
Develop skill trees and assign crew members to skills
Create ship upgrades and assign resources
Develop alien species and negotiate with them
Implement boarding action system and engage in boarding actions
Implement mutiny system and manage crew morale
